about.title: About
about.bio: Apollon Papas founded GYA Media in 2017 and has built his career on the front line of marketing: B2B lead generation, performance advertising, webinars and brand storytelling. He has worked with brands such as Amazon, Samsung, SHEIN, COSRX, Michelin, ZOOM and EY, building the sales systems, funnels and SOPs behind their growth.

items.title: Founding of GYA Media
items.body: Starts GYA Media: digital marketing, business intelligence, B2B lead generation, performance advertising, brand storytelling.

items.title: Growth into international markets
items.body: Expands across the Americas, Europe and the GCC. Integrates 4 companies in marketing, production and IT, builds GYA Media Group, takes on government and other projects in collaboration with Amazon, Samsung, SHEIN, COSRX, Michelin, ZOOM, EY. Builds sales systems, SOPs and marketing funnels. In 2019 he begins training teams in marketing and penetration, and brings the market its first Enterprise AI solutions together with Palantir Technologies and OpenAI.

items.title: Training executives and innovation
items.body: 50+ publications, webinars and consulting. What worked in practice becomes methodology, shared with teams that keep growing.

items.title: Focus on educating the next generation
items.body: Founds the personal brand Apollon Papas, a series of educational services for senior executives as well as young people, in the international and Greek markets. The Career Readiness Sprint opens a safe space for the market's future leaders.

founders.title: From Chaos to Revenue
founders.desc: A work-along sprint designed to educate and lead founders to launch their product or service in under 6 weeks. Start from ideation, end up with a launched product and real clients to deal with.

founders.title: PowerUp!
founders.desc: For busy founders who need clear Enterprise-grade frameworks to create and audit their current digital strategies and efforts, as well as build their first SOPs.

founders.title: The Mentorship
founders.desc: A comprehensive 18-hour course for founders and executives leading teams of 10 to 500 people into a rocket launch. Restructure your mindset, hone your skills, learn new tools, and scale up your operations and efficiency. A programme born from 9,000+ hours of Enterprise consulting, made simple for smaller founders and executives who are looking to adapt their business and leading tactics to the new era of AI with upgraded processes, tools, and global reach.

founders.kicker: Backed by GYA Media & Apollon Papas
founders.title: The Founder VAULT
founders.desc: Online content most of the time is not valid or valuable. You find yourself reading AI-written articles, or posts and reels that do not provide true guidance and a clear path for execution. This hub is the result of 15 years of experience and the client-facing handouts my team and I have written and delivered in in-house trainings, client seminars, and how-to guides made for teams that needed an extra hand. All packed into a useful, immensely valuable vault that gives you direct access to agency knowledge: eBooks, workbooks, tool guides, PDF handouts, checklists, podcasts, interviews, and more.

students.title: Career Readiness Sprint
students.desc: 4 weeks of practical preparation for the job market.
